name: Funder–NGO Fit Rubric v1 (7 criteria, 100 points)
notes: Research-backed rubric built on FundRobin, GrantAssistant.ai, L-I-A prospect model, and the India CSR due-diligence checklist. Source: hand-vetting/Funder_NGO_Fit_Rubric_KABIL.md (org-grant-intelligence repo).

criteria.label: Thematic / Sector Alignment
criteria.guiding_question: Do the funder's stated priority areas match the NGO's actual programme work?

criteria.label: Eligibility & Compliance
criteria.guiding_question: Does the NGO hold the registrations this funder type legally requires (12A, 80G, FCRA, CSR-1 where the funder is Section-135-bound), and meet track-record and documentation requirements?

criteria.label: Geography
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder fund in the NGO's state/region — ideally the specific district, ideally for this kind of work?

criteria.label: Target Population
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's stated beneficiary group match the NGO's actual beneficiaries?

criteria.label: Relationship / Warmth (Linkage)
criteria.guiding_question: Is there an existing, active, or recent funded relationship?

criteria.label: Funding Size & Type Fit
criteria.guiding_question: Do grant size, duration and structure match the NGO's need and scale?

criteria.label: Funder Capacity & Trend
criteria.guiding_question: Is the funder's giving growing, flat, or shrinking?
